parsedVerdict.reasoning: The three controllers handle one concern: turning Express requests into use-case inputs and returning JSON responses. Each one receives its dependencies as the UseCase<I, O> port, reads request fields only through the shared RequestReader helpers (requiredString/optionalString), and follows the same pattern: run the use case, then send 201 + json for creates or json otherwise. There is no business logic or validation rule that is copied between files, and no file goes around the module's abstractions (no direct domain or repository access). ProjectController.create and UserController.create look alike, but that is the normal shape of a thin adapter, not a copied invariant. String(req.params.X) shows up in several places, but it is a trivial coercion, not a rule.
